title: BMS Controls Engineer, Infrastructure
description:
**What to Expect**

Tesla's Infrastructure DesignX team leads the development of innovative solutions for complex R&D and manufacturing facilities across the Bay Area and beyond. We specialize in creating sophisticated infrastructure systems that power next-generation research and production environments.

We are seeking a specialized BMS Controls Engineer to bridge the gap between our Facilities Operations and Data Science teams. The ideal candidate will optimize our Building Management Systems (BMS) not just for operation, but for high-fidelity data acquisition. You will work closely with facilities personnel to instrument systems, validate sensor accuracy, and architect the data pipeline required to feed predictive Machine Learning models.

 **What You'll Do**

* **Field Device & Network Configuration:** Perform low-level field device setup, including setting MAC addresses, baud rates, and communication parameters. Assign, configure, and manage static IP addresses for local DDCs, VFDs, and networked control meters across the internal network
* **DDC Termination & Signal Scaling:** Execute point creation and configuration within the DDC programming environment. Accurately translate physical electrical signals (e.g., 4-20mA loops, 0-10VDC, pulse outputs) into scaled engineering units for the BMS database
* **IT/OT Network Integration:** Bridge the gap between operational technology (OT) and IT by coordinating with network administrators to establish VLANs, configure network switches, and resolve IP conflicts or firewall issues for BMS devices
* Collaborate with facilities staff to identify critical control points and sensors required for ML modeling, translating the complex requirements of the ML team into technical tasks.
* Conduct regular audits of trend data to identify "flatlined" sensors, calibration drifts, or communication drop-outs

By combining self-performed specialty design, construction, and commissioning services, MIS delivers large-scale, multidisciplinary projects with greater control over safety, quality, schedule, and cost.

MIS specializes in the delivery of hyperscale data centers and mission-critical facilities, leveraging expertise across mass grading and site development, wet and dry utilities, fiber and telecommunications infrastructure, ground improvement, deep foundations, structural concrete, power infrastructure, and commissioning.
